Five boundaries to settle

None of these is a gap in the process. Each is a place where two functions can both make a fair claim, and the structure can't be signed off until someone decides.

Not yet in the proposed five

The operating model names five departments. These functions lead work in the process but sit outside those five — each needs a home, or a reason to stand alone.

The wall

Four panels, left to right. Colour is the department, and the number on each note is 1 for lead, 2 for support — the same logic this page is built on.
